title: artemisia kruhsiana subsp. alaskana
intro: Artemisia kruhsiana subsp. alaskana, commonly known as Arctic wormwood, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arctic wormwood are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
